name: Dempsey Francis
events: 1844 onward • Howard County Memory Project — original marriage books Kokomo-Howard County Public Library / Howard County Memory Project Howard County's digitized marriage books include applications and licenses in the early 1900s. For a pre-August-1919 Dempsey Francis marriage, the most relevant books are Vols. 27–30 (Nov 1916 through Sept 1919). Each book has an alphabetical index that points to the original application/license page.

1916–1919 • Howard County digitized marriage-book route Howard County, Indiana Marriage applications/licenses are digitized. For Dempsey and May/Mary before Alberta's birth, inspect Vols. 27–30 indexes and then the original page.

1917–2006 • Woodrow G. Francis identity-collision lead Prior Kokomo Tribune obituary research + independent public death index Independent public indexing confirms Woodrow G. Francis, born 25 Aug 1917, died 11 Sep 2006, lived in Greentown, Howard County, Indiana. Earlier obituary research reported his parents as Dempsey Francis and Myrtle Mae (Jordan) Francis. The obituary parent wording still needs re-verification and there is no proof yet that Woodrow's Dempsey is Alberta's father; do not merge the families.
